summary: P8 verifies P2-P6 compatibility at passed/proxy-ready level and leaves final real gameplay landing to P9.

items.evidence: P8-A/P8-E compatibility tests load the high-detail baseline reference without Chuo_BaseMap and do not modify movement scripts.
items.p9Boundary: P9 may tune movement for final gameplay, but P8 does not rework success/failure rules.

items.evidence: P8-A compatibility report keeps camera flow independent of Chuo_BaseMap and no P8 script couples to final camera gameplay.
items.p9Boundary: P9 may adjust camera framing for final evacuation gameplay.

items.evidence: P8-C/P8-E keeps shelter interaction at proxy level and separates official shelter records from humanitarian candidates.
items.p9Boundary: P9 implements final entrance/safe-floor/evacuation-complete proxy behavior.

items.evidence: P8 scripts expose gameplay-neutral flags and tests assert no success/failure coupling.
items.p9Boundary: P9 may define final failure/congestion rules, but P8 does not change existing P2 result rules.

items.evidence: P8 data artifacts live under Assets/Data/P8 with JsonUtility-compatible schemas and validation preflights.
items.p9Boundary: P9 may consume these artifacts directly and should not redo P8 hazard extraction.

items.item: real shelter loading and marker representation
items.evidence: P8-C/P8-E handoff keeps marker/status support data-only and does not claim final scene object placement.
items.p9Boundary: P9 must verify final marker placement and official shelter labels.

items.evidence: P8 preserves official/non-official separation and keeps humanitarian candidates out of official shelter status.
items.p9Boundary: P9 decides final selectable target behavior while preserving labels.

items.evidence: Existing route files are OSM/EPSG prototype routes and explicitly not official evacuation routes.
items.p9Boundary: P9 may use routes as estimated guidance only after final gameplay validation.

items.evidence: P8 audit has 110 accepted non-official candidates with warning and manual-review fields.
items.p9Boundary: P9 decides whether any become life-first selectable vertical evacuation targets.

items.evidence: P8 keeps qualification metadata separate from gameplay success/failure and does not claim route approval.
items.p9Boundary: P9 must verify final real gameplay mode against route/marker limits.

items.evidence: P8-E route handoff forbids official-route claims when geometry is not road-validated.
items.p9Boundary: P9 must keep any OSM route as estimated prototype guidance unless official route evidence is added later.

items.evidence: P8-C infrastructure and risk-front status can feed navigation-target proxies without final behavior changes.
items.p9Boundary: P9 implements final guidance UX and gameplay consequences.

items.evidence: P8 does not implement P9 crowd/spawn/congestion and keeps NPC assumptions prototype-only.
P8 supplies hazard/front/infrastructure foundations but no final crowd or evacuation-failure behavior.
